name: Retinol
summary: Vitamin A that speeds up cell turnover. Start slow, use at night.

name: Retinal
summary: One step closer to retinoic acid than retinol, so it works faster.

name: Retinyl Palmitate
summary: A gentle retinoid ester. Mild and slow.

name: Hydroxypinacolone Retinoate
summary: A newer retinoid that tends to be less irritating.

name: Adapalene
summary: An acne-focused retinoid sold over the counter.

name: Bakuchiol
summary: Plant extract often used as a gentler retinol alternative. Not a retinoid.

name: Glycolic Acid
summary: The smallest AHA. Exfoliates the surface for glow and texture.

name: Lactic Acid
summary: A gentler AHA that also hydrates.

name: Mandelic Acid
summary: A large, slow AHA. Good for sensitive skin.

name: Salicylic Acid
summary: Oil-soluble exfoliant that gets into pores. Good for blackheads.

name: Betaine Salicylate
summary: A milder BHA alternative to salicylic acid.

name: Gluconolactone
summary: A PHA. Gentle exfoliation that also hydrates.

name: Papain
summary: Papaya enzyme that dissolves dead skin gently.

name: Citric Acid
summary: Usually just adjusts pH at tiny amounts. Not an exfoliant here.

name: Ascorbic Acid
summary: Pure vitamin C. Brightens and protects, but it's acidic and unstable.

name: Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate
summary: A stable, gentle vitamin C derivative.

name: Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate
summary: A stable, gentle vitamin C derivative.

name: Niacinamide
summary: Vitamin B3. Helps oil, redness, pores and the skin barrier.

name: Azelaic Acid
summary: Calms redness and helps with breakouts and dark spots.

name: Benzoyl Peroxide
summary: Kills acne bacteria. Drying and can bleach fabric.

name: Kojic Acid
summary: Fades dark spots. Can irritate some skin.

name: Copper Tripeptide-1
summary: Copper peptide for firmness and repair.

name: Glycerin
summary: Pulls water into skin. A cheap, excellent hydrator.

name: Sodium Hyaluronate
summary: Hyaluronic acid salt. Holds water in skin.

name: Urea
summary: Hydrates. At high % it also softens rough skin.

name: Avena Sativa Kernel Flour
summary: Colloidal oatmeal. Soothes itchy, dry skin.

name: Tocopherol
summary: Vitamin E. Antioxidant that also stabilizes formulas.

name: Ceramide NP
summary: A skin-identical lipid that repairs the barrier.

name: Ceramide AP
summary: A skin-identical lipid that repairs the barrier.

name: Ceramide EOP
summary: A skin-identical lipid that repairs the barrier.

name: Cholesterol
summary: Barrier lipid that works with ceramides.

name: Squalane
summary: Lightweight oil that mimics skin's own.

name: Dimethicone
summary: Silicone that smooths and locks in moisture.

name: Petrolatum
summary: The strongest occlusive. Seals moisture in.

name: Simmondsia Chinensis Seed Oil
summary: Jojoba oil. Close to skin's own sebum.

name: Cetearyl Alcohol
summary: A fatty alcohol that thickens. Not drying, despite the name.

name: Cetyl Alcohol
summary: A fatty alcohol that thickens. Not drying, despite the name.

name: Octocrylene
summary: UVB filter that also stabilizes avobenzone.

name: Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate
summary: Gentle cleanser common in syndet bars.

name: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate
summary: Strong foaming cleanser. Can strip and irritate.

name: Fragrance
summary: Undisclosed scent blend. A common trigger for sensitive skin.

name: Limonene
summary: Citrus fragrance compound and known allergen.

name: Lavandula Angustifolia Oil
summary: Lavender oil. Smells nice, can irritate.

name: Alcohol Denat.
summary: Drying alcohol. Fine low in the list, rough near the top.

name: Methylisothiazolinone
summary: Preservative with a high allergy rate.

name: Phenoxyethanol
summary: The most common preservative. Well tolerated.

name: Sodium Hydroxide
summary: Adjusts pH. Fully neutralized in the formula.

name: Disodium EDTA
summary: Keeps minerals from destabilizing the formula.

name: Isopropyl Palmitate
summary: Light emollient that makes formulas glide.

name: Isopropyl Myristate
summary: Light emollient. Can clog pores for some people.

name: Carthamus Tinctorius Seed Oil
summary: Safflower oil. Rich in linoleic acid, light and non-greasy.

name: Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil
summary: Sunflower oil. Supports the skin barrier.

name: Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil
summary: Argan oil. Nourishing, good for dry skin.

name: Rosa Canina Fruit Oil
summary: Rosehip oil. Rich in fatty acids.

name: Olea Europaea Fruit Oil
summary: Olive oil. Rich, best for dry skin.

name: Cocos Nucifera Oil
summary: Coconut oil. Rich. Can clog pores for some people.

name: Vitis Vinifera Seed Oil
summary: Grapeseed oil. Light, good for oily skin.

name: Cannabis Sativa Seed Oil
summary: Hemp seed oil. Light, high in linoleic acid.

name: Sclerocarya Birrea Seed Oil
summary: Marula oil. Light and absorbs fast.

name: Squalene
summary: Skin's own oil. Squalane is the more stable version.

name: Paraffinum Liquidum
summary: Mineral oil. Very effective at sealing in moisture.

name: Lanolin
summary: Very rich occlusive from sheep's wool.

name: Cera Alba
summary: Beeswax. Thickens and seals in moisture.

name: Cyclopentasiloxane
summary: Silicone that evaporates and leaves a silky feel.

name: Hydrogenated Lecithin
summary: Emulsifier that also supports the barrier.

name: Ceramide NS
summary: A skin-identical lipid that repairs the barrier.

name: Ceramide AS
summary: A skin-identical lipid that repairs the barrier.

name: Linoleic Acid
summary: Fatty acid that supports the barrier.

name: Stearic Acid
summary: Fatty acid that thickens and softens.

name: Glyceryl Stearate
summary: Emulsifier that keeps oil and water mixed.

name: PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil
summary: Helps fragrance and oils dissolve in water.

name: Behenyl Alcohol
summary: A fatty alcohol that thickens. Not drying.

name: Stearyl Alcohol
summary: A fatty alcohol that thickens. Not drying.

name: Arachidyl Alcohol
summary: A fatty alcohol that thickens. Not drying.

name: Potassium Hydroxide
summary: Adjusts pH. Neutralized in the formula.

name: Sodium PCA
summary: Part of skin's natural moisturizing factor.

name: Polyglutamic Acid
summary: Holds even more water than hyaluronic acid.

name: Glycyrrhiza Glabra Root Extract
summary: Licorice. Calms redness and helps even tone.

name: Malic Acid
summary: An AHA, usually a supporting player.

name: Tartaric Acid
summary: An AHA, usually a supporting player.

name: Adenosine
summary: Smooths fine lines. Popular in K-beauty.

name: Benzophenone-3
summary: UV filter. Some people prefer to avoid it.

name: Benzyl Alcohol
summary: Preservative. Not a drying alcohol at these levels.

name: Methylparaben
summary: Preservative. Well studied and low risk.

name: Hamamelis Virginiana Water
summary: Witch hazel. Astringent, can be drying.

name: Melaleuca Alternifolia Leaf Oil
summary: Tea tree oil. Helps blemishes but can irritate.

name: Mentha Piperita Oil
summary: Peppermint oil. Tingly and irritating for many.

name: Citrus Aurantium Dulcis Peel Oil
summary: Citrus oil. Can irritate in sun.

name: Citrus Limon Peel Oil
summary: Citrus oil. Can irritate in sun.

name: Citrus Aurantium Bergamia Fruit Oil
summary: Citrus oil. Can irritate in sun.
